Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Represents a single employee in the RuamChok Fitness HRM system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Employee entity.

name.description: The full name of the employee.

LeaveEntry.title: LeaveEntry
LeaveEntry.description: Records an instance of an employee taking leave.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LeaveEntry entity.

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee who took the leave. (Relationship: Employee 1:N LeaveEntry)

leaveDate.description: The specific date on which the leave was taken.

leaveType.description: The category or type of leave taken (e.g., 'พักร้อน' (Vacation), 'วันมาฆบูชา' (Makha Bucha Day), 'วันเกิด' (Birthday Leave), or a custom holiday name).

durationDays.description: The duration of the leave in days, allowing for half-day increments (e.g., 0.5, 1, 1.5).

EmployeeQuota.title: EmployeeQuota
EmployeeQuota.description: Defines the leave quotas allocated to a specific employee for different leave types.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EmployeeQuota entity.

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee for whom these quotas are set. (Relationship: Employee 1:1 EmployeeQuota)

vacationQuotaDays.description: The total number of vacation days allocated to the employee for the current period.

holidayQuotaDays.description: The total number of public holiday days allocated to the employee for the current period, covering standard and custom holidays.

birthdayQuotaDays.description: The total number of birthday leave days allocated to the employee for the current period.

EmployeeHolidayPermission.title: EmployeeHolidayPermission
EmployeeHolidayPermission.description: Specifies which public and custom holidays an individual employee is permitted to take.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EmployeeHolidayPermission entity.

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee to whom these holiday permissions apply. (Relationship: Employee 1:1 EmployeeHolidayPermission)

allowedHolidayNames.description: An array of strings, where each string is the name of a standard or custom holiday that the employee is permitted to take.

CustomHoliday.title: CustomHoliday
CustomHoliday.description: Defines a custom, non-standard holiday that can be created and managed by administrators.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CustomHoliday entity.

name.description: The descriptive name of the custom holiday (e.g., 'วันศุกร์ที่ 13')..

defaultDays.description: The default number of days allocated for this custom holiday (e.g., 0.5, 1).

AppSetting.title: AppSetting
AppSetting.description: Stores global application-level settings and policy texts that can be configured by administrators.

id.description: Unique identifier for the application setting (e.g., 'systemTitle', 'vacationPolicyText', 'makhaBuchaDate', 'vacationDaysForYear_1').

value.description: The value of the configuration setting, which can be text, dates, or other stringified data.

GroupClass.title: GroupClass
GroupClass.description: Represents a single group class that can be scheduled.

id.description: Unique identifier for the group class.

name.description: The name of the group class (e.g., 'Yoga', 'Zumba').

GroupClassInstructor.title: GroupClassInstructor
GroupClassInstructor.description: Represents an instructor who can teach group classes.

GroupClassTime.title: GroupClassTime
GroupClassTime.description: Represents a specific time slot for group classes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the time slot.

name.description: The time slot in HH:MM format (e.g., '09:00').

GroupClassAttendance.title: GroupClassAttendance
GroupClassAttendance.description: Records an attendance entry for a specific group class, including signatures.

instructorSignature.description: Data URL of the instructor's signature.

staffName.description: Name of the staff member who signed.

staffSignature.description: Data URL of the staff member's signature.

AssessmentServiceRecord.title: Assessment Service Record
AssessmentServiceRecord.description: Records a client's usage of a special assessment service package.

clientSignature.description: Data URL of the client's signature.

is_checked.description: Whether the session has been reviewed/checked in the dashboard.

AuditLog.title: Audit Log
AuditLog.description: Records all administrative and critical changes in the system.
